outlets.name: Deutsche UNESCO-Kommission
outlets.credible: Official German UNESCO commission; the naming authority for the Aachener Dom as Germany's first World Heritage Site (1978). Lone-authority level for the cathedral and its treasury. German-language.

outlets.name: aachen tourist service e.V. / aachen-tourismus.de (charlie.aachen-tourismus.de)
outlets.credible: Aachen's official tourism organisation; editorial POI and gastronomy listings (Route Charlemagne, restaurants & cafés). German-language authority for what the city itself presents to visitors.

outlets.name: Rathaus Aachen / Route Charlemagne (Stadt Aachen)
outlets.credible: Official City of Aachen town-hall site documenting the Rathaus, Krönungssaal and Route Charlemagne. German/English.

outlets.name: Aachener Zeitung
outlets.credible: Aachen's daily newspaper of record; editorial restaurant, culture and Christmas-market coverage. The regional outlet of record for the city. German-language.

outlets.name: Klenkes
outlets.credible: Long-running Aachen city magazine with editorial gastro tests (e.g. the annual Eisdielen-Test). German-language local editorial, not a rating aggregator.

outlets.name: t-online Region Aachen (aachen.t-online.de)
outlets.credible: Regional edition of the national t-online news portal with Aachen restaurant/Michelin and Printen coverage. German-language.

outlets.name: Guide Michelin Deutschland
outlets.credible: The Michelin Guide; lone-authority level for a starred/Bib-Gourmand recommendation (La Bécasse one star, 2026).

outlets.name: Tourismus NRW e.V. (nrw-tourismus.de)
outlets.credible: Official tourism board of North Rhine-Westphalia; editorial listings for Aachen's cathedral, spas, zoo and sights. German-language.

outlets.name: Centre Charlemagne — Neues Stadtmuseum Aachen
outlets.credible: Official site of Aachen's city-history museum on the Katschhof. German/English.

outlets.name: Suermondt-Ludwig-Museum
outlets.credible: Official site of Aachen's civic fine-art museum. German/English.

outlets.name: Ludwig Forum für Internationale Kunst
outlets.credible: Official site of Aachen's contemporary-art museum (Ludwig collection). German/English.

outlets.name: Couven-Museum Aachen
outlets.credible: Official site of Aachen's decorative-arts / bourgeois-interiors museum. German-language.

outlets.name: Aachener Tierpark Euregiozoo
outlets.credible: Official site of Aachen's zoo. German-language.

outlets.name: KuLaDig — Kultur.Landschaft.Digital (LVR)
outlets.credible: Scholarly cultural-landscape/monument database of the Landschaftsverband Rheinland. German-language institutional heritage record (RWTH Reiff-Museum, Frankenberger Viertel).

outlets.name: Aachen schöne Altstadt
outlets.credible: German-language editorial guide to Aachen's old town (shops, cafés, historic sites) written like a local insider; editorial content, not a user-rating aggregator. Used as a corroborating local source.

outlets.name: TravelWorldOnline Traveller
outlets.credible: Established German travel magazine/blog with editorial city and food guides (Aachen specialties, restaurants). German-language editorial, corroborating.

outlets.name: Schwarzaufweiss — Reisemagazin
outlets.credible: German online travel magazine with an editorial feature on Aachen Printen and its main bakeries (Lambertz, Nobis, Van den Daele). German-language editorial.

outlets.name: European Coffee Trip
outlets.credible: Editorial specialty-coffee city guide covering Europe; its Aachen guide names the city's third-wave roasters (MAQII). Niche but genuine editorial authority for coffee, corroborating.

outlets.name: Kaffee-Netz
outlets.credible: Germany's largest specialty-coffee enthusiast community; the long-running 'Aachener Kaffeeszene' thread documents the city's roasters. Corroborating local lead, paired with an editorial source — never a lone pin.

outlets.name: gut-wirtz.de — Aachener Printen (Dokumentationsseite)
outlets.credible: German-language enthusiast reference cataloguing Aachen's Printen bakeries; editorial documentation, not a rating aggregator. Corroborating source for the Printenbäckereien, flagged as niche.

outlets.name: top-aachen
outlets.credible: German-language Aachen city/lifestyle magazine; editorial event coverage (Öcher Bend).

outlets.name: Ruhr Nachrichten
outlets.credible: NRW regional daily; news coverage of the Öcher Bend funfair. German-language.

outlets.name: LINHÉ (linhe.de)
outlets.credible: German lifestyle/food blogger with a findable multi-year body of work incl. an Aachen food guide. Used as a corroborating creator source, never a lone pin (see CREATORS_AACHEN.json).

outlets.name: Wikipedia (de/en)
outlets.credible: Used only for uncontroversial, well-referenced facts (dates, addresses, building history) and always paired with an official/editorial source.
